candidats.titre: File:École Militaire (Paris) - Detail of the central pavilion mansard roof, dormers, and imperial coat of arms relief.jpg
candidats.description: Close-up architectural view highlighting the symmetrical mansard roof configuration of the central pavilion, showing two circular oeil-de-boeuf window dormers framing the monumental French Imperial Eagle coat of arms relief flanked by allegorical stone figures sitting along the upper cornice.

candidats.titre: File:École Militaire (Paris) - Pavillon de la Cavalerie - Mansard roof, central window, and imperial eagle pediment detail.jpg
candidats.description: Close-up architectural view highlighting the upper facade of the Cavalry Wing, featuring its slate mansard roof, a central stone-framed dormer window, and an intricate triangular pediment sculpted with a prominent imperial eagle motif from the Second Empire expansion.

candidats.titre: File:Hôtel de Ville de Paris - Detail of corner pavilion and mansard roofline.jpg
candidats.description: The corner pavilion structure features multi-tiered rows of Corinthian pilasters flanking niche statues of historical figures, topped by a heavy stone cornice, a decorative balustrade, and a steep slate mansard roof equipped with high-relief stone bull's-eye dormers and gilded iron cresting.

candidats.titre: File:Hôtel de Ville de Paris - Upper facade and mansard roofline with statues.jpg
candidats.description: The upper tier features a row of tall stone-framed lucarne dormer windows set into a steep slate mansard roofline, complemented by towering stone chimneys, a decorative roof balustrade gallery, and multiple rows of historical statues occupying individual niches alongside decorative roof sculptures holding spears.
